# Atlas (2024 film) Summary
**Atlas** is a 2024 science fiction film released by Netflix on May 24, 2024. Set in the near future, the story follows Atlas Shepherd (Jennifer Lopez), a skilled analyst with a deep distrust of artificial intelligence, who is the daughter of the designer of Harlan—a humanoid AI terrorist responsible for leading a war against humanity. Decades after Harlan escapes into space, Atlas joins a military mission to capture him on a distant planet, aided by AI-powered mechs called ARCs. Forced into cooperation with the ARC’s onboard AI ("Smith") for survival, Atlas gradually overcomes her AI mistrust as they battle Harlan, who intends to destroy humanity and control Earth's fate. Their conflict ultimately leads to Atlas defeating Harlan with Smith’s help, and hints at Smith's continued existence as Atlas tests a new ARC model.
The film stars Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan, and Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Banks, among others. Written by Leo Sardarian (with rewrites by Aron Eli Coleite) and directed with production in Los Angeles and New Zealand, Atlas became Netflix's top English-language film in its release week, garnering over 60 million global views by June 2024. Although it achieved high viewership, Atlas received largely negative critical reviews, holding a 19% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and scoring 37/100 on Metacritic, with critics citing a lackluster script despite Lopez's committed performance. The film was nominated for a Golden Reel Award in sound editing and a Razzie for Worst Actress (Lopez).
